**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge; no blocking issues were found.

Summary

Makes saved PDF reading positions available earlier, so a fast-loading viewer can restore the last page and zoom before the iframe’s load handler runs. - PDF notes reopen at their saved page after quick switches. No actionable issues found. Review was based on source inspection; tests were not run.
